content.text: Should be suspected in children w/ SXS of arthritis, signs of iridocyclitis (eye redness, pain, blurred vision, photophobia, miosis), generalized adenopathy, splenomegaly, or unexplained rash or prolonged fever
colored pink migratory rash, hepatosplenomegaly, LAD
to adult RA (including morning stiffness), iridocyclitis
: gradual bone loss as patient ages (esp. >70yo)
: USPSTF recommends screening w/ BMD measurement in women ≥65yo
